name: 72730 · Farmington, AR
findings: ZIP 72730 (Farmington) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72730 (Farmington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72730 (Farmington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
